Massive Fire Destroys 1,000 Homes in Tawi Tawi 🔥
A devastating fire broke out in Barangay Lamion, Bongao, Tawi Tawi on the night of February 3, 2026, razing around 1,000 houses. Strong winds helped the fire spread rapidly, destroying footbridges and complicating rescue efforts.
Authorities evacuated families safely via land and sea. Thankfully, no casualties have been reported so far. Survivors are taking temporary shelter at MSU Amilbahar Gymnasium and the Provincial Quarantine Area. Investigations into the cause and damage are ongoing.

LOOK: Nine government employees of Bayawan City, Negros Oriental, were killed after a dump truck they were riding fell off a cliff and landed into a river in Barangay Kalamtukan, Bayawan City on Wednesday, Feb. 4. 

Police Capt. Stephen Polinar, spokesperson of Negros Oriental police, said that nobody survived the accident. 

Based on initial investigation, the vehicle was carrying five containers of crude oil, when the accident happened in a far-flung area at 11:10 a.m. | via Glazyl Masculino

📷: Negros Oriental Police Provincial Office
